body: claimed: issue-worker-high (model: Claude Haiku 5.5, claude-haiku-5-5) · 2026-11-12T12:03Z · worktree/branch issue/1190-mill-op-on-lathe-post · plan: find out whether any mill-family op can post a work-spindle G97/M03 through fanuc-lathe.cps (candidates: Drill on X0, face pass on Y=0, ZX contour); pin refusals with tests or fix the narrowest place

Probe result (issue-worker-high, Claude Haiku 5.5) - escalating to effort:max.

Reproduced through the real document (mill-turn machine with a C rotary, Fanuc lathe post, stock at the spindle axis), gate-free stream into `fanuc-lathe.cps` and the program gate `post_script`:

(a) Mill Drill DR-0400, one hole at X0 Y0, no LiveTool. Post lines: `G50 S6000 | G97 S10000 M03 | M8 | G00 X0 Z20 | G83 Z10 Q12000 F0.008 | G80 | G00 X0 Z30`. Program gate refuses only on the machine maximum: "D1: tool DR-0400 runs 10000 rpm, above the machine's 6000". On-centre drill = work turns, drill stands still; that voicing is correct, the chuck limit is #1191's rule.

(b) 3D Face, flat end mill EM-0400-2FL, over a sliver lying on Y = 0. Post lines: `G50 S6000 | G97 S12000 M03 | M8 | G00 X-28 Z30 | G01 X-28 Z4 F0.0083 | G01 X28 Z4 F0.025`. The post writes NO refusal for the meridian pass; the work spindle is commanded at the mill's 12000 rpm and the tool stands still. Only the machine maximum stops it (gate: "F1: tool EM-0400-2FL runs 12000 rpm, above the machine's 6000"). With a higher machine maximum this posts. This IS the wrong output: a face-mill pass that stays on the meridian is indistinguishable in the stream from a turning facing pass.

(c) 2D contour in ZX, engrave on centre, mill Thread: NOT probed (time box).

Why it cannot be fixed narrowly here: the post sees only tool number/name and section records. Nothing in the stream carries the operation family or whether the tool turns, so the lathe post cannot refuse a milling pass without also refusing real turning passes. The program gate (`posting.rs` validate loop) knows the family but not that the mounted post is a lathe post (`post_script` takes script text). A correct fix needs a new stream parameter (family or spindle owner) in the app, the CNC intermediate spec, the post engine and the lathe script: several crates, a format change. Bigger than effort:high.

Held work: none pushed. Probe test source (`crates/app/tests/lathe_mill_family.rs`, probe only, no assertions) is discarded with the worktree; the two posted-line results above are the reproduction. Label raised to effort:max; claim released.
Next for an effort:max worker: decide the stream owner-of-spindle parameter (CNC-INTERMEDIATE + engine), refuse section-without-LiveTool milling passes on the lathe post by name ("a milling operation on a turning spindle: ..."), keep the on-centre drill voicing, and probe (c).

Re-rated `P0`: the probe above shows wrong posted output is reachable. A 3D Face pass with an end mill that stays on Y = 0 on a mill-turn posts `G97 S12000 M03` and feed moves - the WORK spindle at the milling tool's rpm, the tool standing still - and nothing but the machine's maximum rpm stops it; with a mill at or under the machine maximum it posts. The first worker (effort:high tier) escalated to `effort:max` on the view that the post cannot tell a milling pass from a turning pass without a new stream parameter. Note for the next worker (orchestrator): the app-side program gate already knows each section's operation kind (`op_streams` and the family door `Family::admits` in `posting.rs`, which is where a milling op on an EDM machine is refused by name since #551): refusing there needs no new stream parameter - check that route before changing the stream format.

Route taken (issue-worker-max): the smaller one - a law at the program gate, no stream parameter, no post script change, goldens byte-identical. Both reproductions re-verified on main first: (a) the on-centre Drill posts `G97 S10000 M03` / `G83` and still does; (b) the Face pass along Y = 0 posted `G97 S12000 M03` / `G01 X-24 Z4` through both lathe scripts with no refusal, and is now refused by name at every post entry point before a line is written. Through a lathe post only turning kinds, sections whose path states C, and a Drill with every cutting move on the spindle axis along +Z pass; the other 28 kinds are refused by name. The shared predicate for the workholding limit (PR #1191) is `lathe_voice::on_work_spindle` / `lathe_voice::voice_of`. Decision: `docs/decisions/1190-mill-op-on-lathe-post.md`.

Left open and filed: #1199 (a user's own lathe script that declares no `capabilities` is not recognised as a turning dialect, so the door does not fire for it).
